# Vix

> Vix is a keyboard-friendly terminal text editor (a "Simple Terminal Rust
> IDE") built on ratatui: a thin App shell over 102 focused `vix-*` member
> crates in a Cargo workspace (edition 2024).

Development is specification-driven: each crate owns a spec at
`crates/<crate>/spec/index.md`; cross-cutting and app-level specs live under
`spec/`. When behavior and spec disagree, decide which is correct and make
them match. [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/AGENTS.md) is the canonical entry point for both
human and AI contributors — read it first.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/AGENTS.md): entry point — what Vix is, build/test/lint, hard
  rules, non-negotiable conventions, where things live, the change checklist
- [index.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/index.md): user-facing overview — features, install & run,
  configuration, license
- [docs/index.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/index.md): the full documentation map
- [spec/index/index.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/index/index.md): specification overview — goals,
  dependency crates, build/run

## User guides

- [Architecture](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/architecture/index.md): workspace layout (App shell +
  `vix-*` member crates), event flow, rendering, theming, i18n, configuration,
  testing
- [Keybindings](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/keybindings/index.md): every keyboard shortcut and mouse
  gesture, including keymaps
- [Configuration](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/configuration/index.md): settings file, every key, CLI
  flags
- [Keymaps](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/keymaps/index.md): Apple, VSCode, Emacs, Vi, Spacemacs,
  IntelliJ, Eclipse, Sublime Text
- [Menus](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/menus/index.md), [Themes](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/themes/index.md),
  [Internationalization](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/internationalization/index.md)
- [Language Server Protocol](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/language-server-protocol/index.md):
  diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, completion
- [Debugger](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/debugger/index.md): Debug Adapter Protocol — breakpoints,
  stepping, call stack, variables, watches
- [Database Workbench](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/db/index.md): SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL —
  connections, schema tree, query editor, transactions, history, export
- [Org mode](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/org/index.md): headlines, TODO cycling, table editor,
  Org-roam, export
- [Git Panel](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/docs/git-panel/index.md): status, diff, blame, stage/unstage/
  revert per hunk

## Specification (source of truth)

- [CI/CD](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/ci/index.md): GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg pipelines; the local
  parity gate (`scripts/check`)
- [Navigation](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/navigation/index.md), [Tools menu](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/tools/index.md),
  [Comparisons](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/comparisons/index.md), [Test strategy](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/spec/test/index.md)
- [agents/share/crate-map.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/agents/share/crate-map.md): every crate, module,
  and file

## Contributor guidance

- [agents/conventions.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/agents/conventions.md): coding style and patterns
- [agents/workflow.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/agents/workflow.md): the spec-driven workflow in detail
- [agents/share/glossary.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/agents/share/glossary.md): shared terminology
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/vixide/vix/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): notable changes, newest release first
